description: Builder-generated LP20 LPU-only bundle with two deployed 8-chip partitions (1 and 2) and no prop-sync chain. Each partition is its own one-node unit. The operator refuses LPU-only (single/specDecode) projections with more than one unit per model, so lpr is null; agentPods and novaStages are the per-pod view the units define for runtimes (Nova runs several single-reservation units as independent stages).

refusal.operator: LPU-only workloads require exactly one lpuUnits entry per model; this bundle has 2
